source: PLACEHOLDER for the AI design step, from the owner's Kitchen Studio prototype (https://claude.ai/artifact/Tkd2r8vTUswCs3ioJnGjqg, 2026-11-08; owner: "a placeholder AI design animation (with no actual AI design)"). None of these numbers are the shop's: the AI designer will choose cabinets from the shop's design rules and catalog instead (OA-3). Cabinet types and their heights and depths come from the catalog.

fill.note: The prototype's recipe: split each stretch into equal cabinets no wider than the largest width, in whole steps, and give what is left to a filler.

cabinets.note: Catalog codes the placeholder uses, by job.

visual.note: For drawing the 3D view only (visual approximation, BUILD_SPEC 5.5); never sent to the shop.

appliances.note: Rough appliance shapes for the 3D view only, from the prototype; real sizes come from confirmed appliance specs (OA-4).
